title: Rename many files at once
goal: Give a group of files the same name with a number

steps.say: Select the files you want to rename.
steps.find: the files in the Finder window

steps.say: Control click one of them and choose Rename.
In the first menu, choose Format.
steps.find: the first menu in the Rename window

steps.say: Type the new name in the Custom Format box.
